verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules or automation engine that maps events to actions. Webhooks only deliver event notifications to the user's own code, which is a developer building block. Dunning, renewals and proration are fixed built-in behaviors or settings, not rules the user defines. Meters aggregate events for billing and do not trigger actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
